title: 反转字符串
problem_statement_md:
编写一个程序，将一个字符串作为输入，并输出将其反转后的字符串。

给定的代码将一个字符串作为输入，并将其转换为一个**char**数组，该数组包含了字符串中的字符作为其元素。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Reverse a String[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Write a program to take a string as input and output its reverse.
The given code takes a string as input and converts it into a [b]char[/b] array, which contains letters of the string as its elements. 

[b]Sample Input:[/b]
hello there

[b]Sample Output: [/b]
ereht olleh 
[note]You can loop through the char array, starting from the end, using [b]arr.length[/b] to get the size of the array.[/note]
hint_md: 可以循环遍历char数组，从末端开始，使用`arr.length`来获得数组的大小。
